A front-facing window reveals the second hand as it moves, marking time continuously rather than counting minutes. Crafted in stainless steel and powered by a Japanese Miyota quartz movement, Pulse (Locket) carries forward the bracelet-forward design of the original Pulse, finished with a push-button clasp for a secure, close fit on the wrist. The locket opens and closes, creating space for both what is visible and what remains personal. In a BREDA first, engraving can be added to both the exterior and interior surfaces, allowing the wearer to choose what is shared and what is held close.
